$comment: Every factual default the proforma (and later the site) relies on. A claim with verified:false is shown as unverified in the UI and never silently used as a default. dateChecked is when a person last confirmed the source.

claims.statement: Washington state REET is graduated: 1.10% to $525,000; 1.28% to $1,525,000; 2.75% to $3,025,000; 3.00% above, for sales 2023-01-01 to 2026-12-31.
claims.source: Washington Department of Revenue, Real estate excise tax (RCW 82.45.060); Pierce County Treasurer excise tax rate sheet for 2023-01-01 to 2026-12-31

claims.statement: From 2027-01-01 the thresholds move to $551,000 / $1,551,000 / $3,051,000 under the RCW 82.45.060 four-year adjustment; rates unchanged.
claims.source: RCW 82.45.060 adjustment formula; figures from a law-firm summary, not yet published by DOR
claims.note: Confirm on dor.wa.gov once the 2027 threshold notice is posted.

claims.statement: Local REET for the City of Seattle (location code 1726) is 0.50%, in addition to the state tax.
claims.source: Washington Department of Revenue, Local Real Estate Excise Tax Rates, effective May 1, 2026, King County section

claims.statement: REET is the seller's obligation; the proforma charges it at the sale, not at the purchase, unless the buyer agrees to pay it.
claims.source: RCW 82.45.080 (tax is an obligation of the seller)

claims.statement: King County publishes no single citywide levy rate; the rate depends on the parcel's levy code. The proforma requires the parcel's actual annual tax, from the Assessor's eReal Property search.
claims.source: King County Assessor, 2026 taxes overview and eReal Property search
claims.note: No default. The field is blank and required.

claims.statement: SDCI's 75th-percentile intake-to-issuance time in City control for pre-approved DADU plans is 60 calendar days (goal 30); the applicant's total elapsed time is roughly twice the days in City control, about 4 months.
claims.source: SDCI, Construction Permit Performance (PACT), data as of October 1, 2025
claims.note: Custom designs take longer; the risk flag uses 4 months.

claims.statement: Residential rental property is depreciated straight-line over 27.5 years; land is not depreciable.
claims.source: IRS Publication 946, How To Depreciate Property (residential rental property, GDS recovery period)

claims.statement: An accessory dwelling unit may not be separated from the principal unit through subdivision; a separately saleable second unit must be a second principal dwelling on its own unit lot.
claims.source: SDCI, Summary of Updated Rules in Neighborhood Residential Zones (Council Bill 120993), January 2026, Subdivision

claims.statement: DADU construction cost of $350 per square foot, construction only.

claims.statement: Design, permits, fees and utility connections of about $50,000 for a DADU.
claims.label: Pencil estimate, as of October 2026

claims.statement: A finished DADU resells for about $800 per sf at 800 sf and $680 per sf at 1,000 sf, interpolated between, flat outside 500 to 1,000 sf.
claims.label: Pencil estimate, as of October 2026

claims.statement: Downside: hard cost +10%, rent -5%, exit cap +0.5 pt, permit +2 months. Upside: hard cost -5%, rent +5%, exit cap -0.25 pt.
